_about: Sakura: a calm cherry-blossom night in soft pinks and white with a touch of plum on near-black, paired with Omarchy rose-pine. Original art generated 2026-09-24 with imagegen (src/ holds prompts, renders and sidecars) and animated procedurally by src/animate.py into seamless 12 s loops: a blossom branch swaying before a full moon with falling petals, two koi circling a moonlit pond with petals floating on the current, a torii garden drifting under falling petals on the pump, and a lantern-hung branch with falling petals behind a script clock, date and weather on the 8.8".
